mechanism_narrative: A continued decline in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES over the past month signals weaker commuting and fewer in-person trips, which will keep retail-and-recreation mobility below its prior four-week mean over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT remained around -25% and WORKPLACES around -15% to -16% through t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises above its last-28-day mean while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES stay near current levels for the next 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while TRANSIT stays deeply negative, more activity is concentrated at home and discretionary shopping shifts to non-physical channels, pulling RETAIL_REC down within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT below -20 and RESIDENTIAL above +10 simultaneously
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is about +13% and TRANSIT about -25% in t-0w
failure_condition: If the TRANSIT< -20 and RESIDENTIAL> +10 regime holds but RETAIL_REC does not fall relative to the prior two-week mean within 14 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained improvement in GROCERY_PHARM indicates more essential-trip activity and neighborhood foot traffic, which tends to spill into nearby retail visits and lift RETAIL_REC over a four-week window.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stayed positive from t-2w through t-0w
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM remains positive but RETAIL_REC does not improve relative to the last four weeks over the next 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS mobility before winter indicates weather-tolerant out-of-home activity and more weekend trips, which should translate into higher retail-and-recreation mobility within one week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 5 points week-on-week after a prior trough
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS improved from -18.4 at t-3w to -10.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS rises by at least 5 points week-on-week but RETAIL_REC does not rise in the following week, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both stop falling and begin to recover together, that signals easing restrictions or better compliance with return-to-work norms, which should raise retail mobility over the next two to four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT each increase for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:both series were still negative but flattened near t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rise for two straight weeks yet RETAIL_REC stays below its prior four-week mean over the next 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A higher RESIDENTIAL share together with weak WORKPLACES mobility reflects time displaced from offices into homes, which reduces weekday shopping opportunities and pushes RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed around +13% while WORKPLACES stayed around -15%
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays elevated while WORKPLACES remains depressed and RETAIL_REC nonetheless rises within 14 days, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp improvement in TRANSIT from its current depressed level is a leading sign that travel constraints are loosening; retail-and-recreation mobility should then improve after a short lag.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT increases by more than 3 points week-on-week from a base below -25
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from -27.7 at t-3w to -25.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: If TRANSIT rises more than 3 points from a base below -25 and RETAIL_REC does not improve in the following week, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS rise together, people are still making local essential and leisure trips, which supports nearby discretionary shopping and keeps RETAIL_REC from declining over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stayed positive while PARKS recovered from -18.4 to -10.0
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both remain at or above their current levels but RETAIL_REC still falls relative to the last four weeks over the next 28 days, the hypothesis is rejected.
